dex.entry: A taller, more confident mushroom-kin with a fully developed cap and a ring of satellite cap-growths around its torso. It exhales layered spore clouds with varied effects. The bridge form — visibly more capable than Sporeling but with that same odd-cute mushroom energy.

art.silhouette: Human-height mushroom form, broader cap with bioluminescent gill-lines underneath, satellite caps on its shoulders, dusty mauve-green coloured; stance is wide and assured.
